name: Dire Wolf
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3 and Stealth +4. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A heavy gray wolf with a broad muzzle, thick shoulders, large paws, and a low bushy tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules, Version 1.0 (November 2018), p. 123.
sections.Traits:
Keen Hearing and Smell. Apply advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on either hearing or smell.
Pack Tactics. The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally of the wolf is within 5 ft. of the target and is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. +5 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit by Bite must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.

name: Flying Snake
otherStatistics: Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 11. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A small jade-green serpent with muted gold banding and a pair of tapered reptilian wings.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules, Version 1.0 (November 2018), p. 128.
sections.Traits: Flyby. Leaving an enemy’s reach while flying does not provoke an opportunity attack from that enemy.
sections.Actions: Bite. +6 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1 piercing damage and 7 (3d4) poison damage. The poison is part of the hit and has no saving throw.
